create_pointclouds_batch: create a Pointclouds object from a list of tensors with shape (num_points, 3)
subsample_pointclouds: subsample each cloud in a Pointclouds batch to at most max_points points
estimate_normals_pointclouds: estimate normals for each point in a Pointclouds batch using neighborhood size
join_pointclouds_as_batch: join a list of Pointclouds objects into a single batched Pointclouds object
get_bounding_boxes_pointclouds: compute axis-aligned bounding boxes for each cloud in a Pointclouds batch
